_note: Tabs per case type (domain pages are case type configuration, Ruben 18 October 2026). `tabs` lists the case page's tabs a case of this type shows, in order, by tab id (the tab's `id`, else its `widgetId`). The case page reads it through nextcloud-vue `tabsFrom`; a case type that lists none shows the tabs as declared. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.26.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: The tabs of a case of this type, in order, by the id of the case page's tab. Empty shows the default tabs.
